Package ca.refundr.highspring.domain.product

Record Class ProductResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
ca.refundr.highspring.domain.product.ProductResponse
Record Components:
id - catalog product id
name - display name shown in the shop
unitPrice - list price before category discount (currency units)
imageUrl - absolute or path URL for the product image
categoryId - category this product belongs to
categoryCode - short category code (e.g. for rules/debug)
categoryName - human-readable category label
discountPercent - category discount applied before sales tax (0–100)
public record ProductResponse(UUID id, String name, BigDecimal unitPrice, String imageUrl, UUID categoryId, String categoryCode, String categoryName, BigDecimal discountPercent) extends Record
A product a shopper can add to a purchase, including its category discount.

      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object).
